text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: The Three

text_block_list.text: Hmph! You're not half bad!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I could say the same thing! I'm not giving
up the next foothold to you,
though!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Don't you two dare forget about me! LET'S
GOOO!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
The three Umamusume throw themselves
into ascending the cliff,
their sights set on
the chapel.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: All for the sake of proving their passion...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(I'm lacking oomph, huh? I'll show you
oomph!)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Wow, wow, wooow! Just when I thought I
heard the pitter-patter of
pretty little
footsteps, three lovely gems show up at
my doorstep! ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I'm not gonna let you turn me away this time!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...Oh my. ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: The time has come for you all to propose.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
But as a penalty, you must go last, Air
Groove. ☆ Understood?
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Ngh... Understood.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
First up is Каваками Принцесс. Tell
me—what does racewear mean to
you? ☆
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
To me, racewear represents my ideal self...
It is the proof of my vow
to become a
princess with both elegance and dignity.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
In order to become a lady worthy of
exquisite attire and to be
discovered by
my very own Prince Charming one day...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
I vow to continue walking side by side with
my racewear, no matter
how challenging
the path may be!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
...Hmmm, very good! ♪ What a lovely vow,
my dear!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Next, Мэдзиро Добер. Let's hear your beautiful vow! ☆
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I don't have a clear dream like Kawakami...
but I do want to become a
better version
of myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I want to be proud of myself and run my
races with confidence. I want
to be able to
do my very best against every opponent I
meet.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I want to become an undefeatable
Umamusume who can stand against
even
my role models and other Mejiro
members—and for that, I need
my own
racewear!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
To me, my racewear is an essential
presence that supports and
propels me
forward, lacking in confidence as I am.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I may still be inexperienced, but I want to
walk hand in hand with my
racewear, so I
can bloom into my full potential one day!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Sorry... That was more of a wish than a
vow.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I don't mind at all! ♪ I accept your
unique proposal!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Now, last but not least...
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Then when I grow up, I'm going to be like
you and get a first-rate
designer to create
my very own racewear!
text_block_list.name: Young Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll wear a racing costume like yours and
become a beautiful and
amazing
Umamusume just like you, Mother!
text_block_list.name: Young Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It makes me so happy to hear you say
that. ♪ In that case, I have to
cheer you on
with all my might!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text:
To me, racewear represents admiration. It
is a symbol of what I strive
to become.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a child, I've desired to
become as beautiful as my
mother, and
that desire has not waned.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
One day, I will don a set of racewear just
as beautiful as hers and
become the
Empress who embodies the ideal
Umamusume. And to
make that future a
reality...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I vow to continue being someone worthy
of her racewear... I swear to
pave the path
we'll walk together with honor and glory.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. ♪ A wonderful fire has lit up in
your eyes. ☆
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time to announce the results of
the audition...
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Каваками Принцесс, Мэдзиро Добер, and Air
Groove...
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: You all pass!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: I did it... I was chosen to be a muse!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Oui! Félicitations, everyone! ♪ Please
allow me to amend what I said
before, Air
Groove.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Your beauty is most splendid. ♪ My
fountain of inspiration is
positively
overflowing! ☆
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing what you'll
create. I'm sure our outfits
will be on equal
footing with your master's work.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Quite right! You'd better be prepared for
them. ☆
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
By the way, Ms. Beauty, have you seen
Mayano? She should've been
the first one
to get here.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Hm? You girls are the only ones to have
reached the chapel so far.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган, right? I wonder what
she is up to right now?
Hehe. ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
